purpose: Visitor scene illustrations from staging, not released gameplay, public-route proof or a matched reference comparison.
setup: Native destination entry followed by explicit placement of the production on-foot controller at the scene-authored postcard viewpoint. All final look direction is acquired through actual CDP touch drags; no free camera. Phone JPEGs are the entire actual 390×844 page, including its native HUD.
